name: Fundrizer – Donation Plugin | Fundraising Software
author: LokusWP

sections.description:
Fundrizer is a WordPress plugin designed to help you create a fundraising platform or donation website.

With this plugin, you can set up donation pages to receive contributions from supporters or manage multiple fundraising campaigns for your nonprofit organization — all without transaction fees.

This plugin is built for the Block Editor, allowing you to customize and visualize each block. You can create a personalized donation website or fundraising platform that matches your style.

Demo

Interface

  • Funding Form: Allows funders to quickly select predefined amounts, streamlining the funding process and potentially increasing conversion rates by reducing friction.
  • Funding Showcase: Displays a list of active fundraising campaigns, providing clear visibility into diverse campaigns aligned with funders’ interests.
  • Funding Page: Provides detailed information, including the campaign goal, progress, impact, and funding allocation. This approach engages funders deeply and inspires larger contributions through transparency and compelling storytelling.
  • Funding Wall: Shows a list of donations received, including both pending and completed transactions.

Management

  • Metrics: Setting metrics for campaigns helps define and measure success criteria, making campaign goals more realistic and achievable.
  • Tags: Adding tags to campaigns helps organize and categorize them, making management easier.
  • Analytics: Understanding audience behavior through data allows for informed decisions, leading to better outcomes.
  • Funders Data: Track how many funders you have and the total amount they are contributing.

Payment

  • WooCommerce Integration: The Fundrizer plugin seamlessly integrates with WooCommerce, offering a flexible and robust payment system. It supports multiple currencies and various payment methods to make receiving donations easier.
  • Supported Methods: Fundrizer leverages WooCommerce’s wide range of supported payment gateways, ensuring compatibility with popular methods like credit cards, PayPal, and more.
  • Add More Payment Methods: Enhance your donation platform by adding new payment methods using the Banking Blocks for WooCommerce plugin, ensuring donors have more options to contribute.

Notification

  • Email: Send notifications to funders about their contributions via email.
  • WhatsApp: Integrate with UnoWA to help you send notifications directly to funders via WhatsApp.
sections.faq:
Where can I get help if this plugin has issues?

For support with this plugin, please visit the Support Forums.

Privacy Policy

Fundrizer uses Appsero SDK to collect some telemetry data upon user’s confirmation. Integrating Appsero SDK DOES NOT IMMEDIATELY start gathering data, without confirmation from users in any case. Learn more about how Appsero collects and uses this data.
